items.q: What is Beyond the Restroom: 30-Day Return-to-Work OS?
items.a: The 30 Days Before and After Maternity Leave Ends - Rights, Pumping Logistics and the Evening Bridge A dated operating system for the return: rights-backed ask locked in writing, feeding lane chosen, freezer bank built, mornings drilled - week one becomes execution, not improvisation.
Employed/breastfeeding mother in the final month of maternity leave, dreading the return - pumping logistics, the morning hand-off, supply drop fear, guilt math - with no plan beyond a start date

You get 5 components: The 30-Day Return-to-Work Guide + rights block; The Operating Checklist (before/after anchors); Feeding-at-Work Decision Card; Scripts for the Working Mother; Red flags & rescue routing (in guide/checklist). Together they let you runs dated before/after playbooks and negotiates adjustments from legal footing in writing.
No. Educational content - not medical or legal advice. It does not replace professional assessment or care.
